subject: general
question: If x = 32.5, y = 34.6 and z = 30.9, then the value of x³ + y³ + z³ – 3xyz is 0.98k, where k is equal to:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Value of x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = (Sum/2) × [Sum of square of differences]

Sum = 32.5 + 34.6 + 30.9 = 98

Sum of squared differences = (−2.1)² + (3.7)² + (−1.6)² = 4.41 + 13.69 + 2.56 = 20.66

Expression value = 49 × 20.66 = 1012.34

k = 1012.34 ÷ 0.98 = 1033

**∴ The correct answer is 1033.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x = 32.5, y = 34.6, z = 30.9

**Formula Used:**

x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = 1/2(x + y + z)[(x − y)² + (y − z)² + (z − x)²]

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum (x + y + z) = 32.5 + 34.6 + 30.9 = 98

⇒ (x − y) = 32.5 − 34.6 = −2.1

⇒ (y − z) = 34.6 − 30.9 = 3.7

⇒ (z − x) = 30.9 − 32.5 = −1.6

⇒ x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = 1/2 × 98 × [(−2.1)² + (3.7)² + (−1.6)²]

⇒ 0.98k = 49 × [4.41 + 13.69 + 2.56]

⇒ 0.98k = 49 × 20.66

⇒ 0.98k = 1012.34

⇒ k = 1012.34 ÷ 0.98

⇒ k = 1033

**∴ The correct answer is 1033.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Standard Algebraic Identity

x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = (x + y + z)(x² + y² + z² − xy − yz − zx). This is the base form used for most expansions.

Zero Sum Property

If (x + y + z) = 0, then x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz. This is a very common shortcut in competitive exams.

Square Sum Variation

x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = (x + y + z)[(x + y + z)² − 3(xy + yz + zx)]. This version is useful when the sum of products is given.</p
